source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Improve a ranged attack's BS by 1 when it targets a visible unit with at least one model at ground level and either:

- the attacker is on a terrain feature section 3" or more high
- the attacker is **TOWERING** and the target is within 12"

Examples: unit A, entirely on terrain at least 3" high, gets the bonus against a target with models at ground level; model B is at ground level but **TOWERING**, and its target is within 12" with models at ground level, so it gets the bonus too.
